en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of an elegant, tree‑lined avenue in a spa town. Ornate multi‑story buildings with decorative facades, balconies, awnings, and ground‑floor shops line the left side of the street. Signs on the buildings include hotel names and shop fronts. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street and a few horse‑drawn carriages are visible on the right. Printed text at the top identifies the scene as Marienbad, Obere Kaiserstraße, with the building Fürstenhof noted.
